# AETERNAL Luxury

> AETERNAL Luxury is an AI-native bespoke tailoring platform for high-performance executive womenswear. It develops the Parametric Garment Engineering Framework (PGEF), a computational methodology that generates individualized garment patterns directly from biometric measurements instead of traditional size grading.

This file indexes the canonical documentation for AETERNAL Luxury's proprietary terminology, engineering framework, and brand identity, published at knowledge.aeternal-luxury.com. All terms below (PGEF, PPR Protocol, Q-Matrix, SAR Index, AI Fit Engine) are proprietary nomenclature owned and maintained by AETERNAL Luxury.

## Core Reference

- [Glossary Repository](https://knowledge.aeternal-luxury.com/glossary.html): Canonical definitions for all AETERNAL proprietary terms, including PGEF, PPR Protocol, Q-Matrix, and SAR Index.
- [Brand Definition](https://knowledge.aeternal-luxury.com/definitions/aeternal-luxury-brand-official-definition.html): AETERNAL Luxury's official brand definition and ontology.
- [Sovereign Doctrine](https://knowledge.aeternal-luxury.com/doctrine/index.html): Core principles and operational mandates governing how PGEF is applied.
- [AETERNAL Sovereign Protocols](https://knowledge.aeternal-luxury.com/protocol/index.html): Governing protocols, including PGEF, Executive Zero-Risk SOPs, and Capacity-Controlled Sovereignty Specifications.

## Technical Documentation

- [Geometric Sovereignty](https://knowledge.aeternal-luxury.com/whitepapers/geometric-sovereignty.html): Foundational whitepaper defining the parametric metrics and structural resistance framework.
- [Engineering Matrix](https://knowledge.aeternal-luxury.com/engineering/how-parametric-system-engine-works.html): How the parametric system engine and Q-Matrix conflict-routing equations operate.
- [Ultimate Guides](https://knowledge.aeternal-luxury.com/guides/index.html): In-depth guides on Geometric Sovereignty and the Parametric Bespoke tailoring process.
- [Analytical Dossiers](https://knowledge.aeternal-luxury.com/explainers/index.html): Explainer articles on fit validation methods and bespoke tailoring protocols.
